verdict.rationale: Datalab documents an official Python SDK covering conversion (parse), structured extraction, pipelines, form filling and file management, plus a CLI and SDK versioning guarantees. Nothing in the evidence shows a TypeScript SDK, typed interfaces, job management through the SDK, or documented defaults. Missing for 10: an official TypeScript SDK, evidence of typed SDK interfaces, SDK coverage of jobs/polling/webhooks and segmentation, documented sensible defaults, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, official typed SDKs for Python and TypeScript cover the full API — parse, extract, jobs — with sensible defaults

citations.quote: The Datalab Python SDK provides a simple interface for document conversion, pipelines, structured extraction, form filling, and file management.
The SDK provides a simple interface to convert documents to Markdown, HTML, JSON, or chunks.
Fill PDF and image forms with structured field data using the Datalab SDK.
